seoDescription: Luigi Contessi: entrepreneur and content creator. Cars, watches, yachts, travel — what he tries himself.

intro.title: Luigi Contessi
intro.lead: Italian, based in Paris. Former pilot, entrepreneur, luxury and travel influencer.
intro.body: I founded and run a private jet company, so I live luxury travel from the inside. I also co-star in season 2 of the series Creatives, on Amazon Prime Video, and I am Global Brand Ambassador for Shokz and Rokid. On Instagram, more than 1.8 million people follow what I try: cars, watches, hotels, destinations.

items.title: The start
items.text: One idea became a movement. From day one, a single rule: authenticity.

items.title: Growth
items.text: Partnerships with demanding brands. Every collaboration pushed the work further.

items.title: The collection
items.text: Contessi Boutique opens. A personal vision made tangible: to wear, to live.

items.title: Recognition
items.text: Named Best Italian Influencer, Luxury Lifestyle 2024/25. Tourism ambassador for China and Egypt.

rules.title: What you can expect from me

items.title: I test before I talk
items.text: I recommend nothing I haven’t used.

items.title: I also say what’s wrong
items.text: A review with no flaws is not a review.

items.title: I flag every partnership
items.text: When a brand pays me, it says so.

quote.text: Every piece of content should move, inspire, leave a mark.

together.title: Are you a brand?
together.body: Let’s see what we can do together.
